notes.title: Hotfix For V1.9
notes.content:
Note: Is anyone playing with the RX 5500 and experiencing the black light issue?  We are looking into buying a 5000 series for debugging this light issue, but would prefer not to spend too much.

  Hello everyone, we have a quick hotfix for ya.  We made a few changes to the lighting and we need people with the AMD 5700XT to test the latest patch.  We really aren't sure if the issue has been resolved to be honest(Since we do not have any at the studio) but we made a few changes that MAY have fixed the black light issue.

Changes Made:

-Direct texture look up removed for shadow sampling and replaced with standard texture sampling.  
-Screen resolution added to options menu.
-GPU vram usage reduced in attempt to optimize for lower end hardware.  

Hope everyone had a fantastic Halloween!

notes.title: 40% Performance/FPS Increase, Improved Pathfinding, Fixed Bugs. v1.6
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7G8oilnhrbo

HOTFIX:  Mods are back!  Sorry about that everyone.  Also fixed some bugged trees in Modern City.



Hello everyone!  In this exciting update, we focus on performance and pathfinding improvements.  Here is the list of what's changed.


- 30-40% performance increase.  This means larger battles at higher FPS.

-Massive pathfinding improvements.  Path searching up to 3 times faster, and improved path sharing in groups.

- Another 30% performance increase can be obtained using threaded rendering in experimental beta version.(see instructions below on how to activate).

-Project was upgraded to Unity engine 2018, which contributed to some of the performance increase.

-Multi core CPUs are better utilized.

-Bug fixed which caused units to become 'brain dead' and walk continuously in one direction.

-Invisible/pink Tornado trooper bug fixed.

-Walls added to the cliff edges in Atlantis City.



WANT ANOTHER 30% PERFORMANCE BOOST?!

Instructions:

- Right click on UEBS in your Steam library and click properties.

- Go to the 'Betas' tab and select the 'uebsmultithreaded' beta. Launch game.


This will activate an experimental build of the game.  It uses a Unity engine feature which better handles large amount of characters being rendered.  
BEWARE.  This feature is not stable on all machines, and it known for crashes.  So do not be surprised if you experience crashes.  If you are experiencing too many problems, please revert to the 'default' build.


Well I hope you enjoy this lightning fast performance upgrade everyone!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: 2 New Maps, Max Armies Increase, AI Improvements - Update V1.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28377569/0671d730bfbd99ca4e2076c338c785d5c5f837d2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28377569/5ead9b11df364210bbff82b7647c8771eaa44c01.jpg[/img]

 Hello everyone!  We have a big update for you today!  


Notes:

- 2 new maps are now live.  'City Of Atlantis' & 'War Torn'.

- New "groups" added to battle editor.  Allows you to have multiple armies on one team.  Each team can have 9 separate armies.

-Inverted mouse is now a thing!  You can chose to have inverted mouse on fly cam or in possession/fps mode.

-Super speed boost added to fly cam mode.  Double tap shift to activate!

-Ranged units now have farther attack range when they have the high ground.

-AI vision and enemy choosing has been drastically improved.  They are far more likely to spot an enemy as they get closer even in massive confusing battles.

-Rare bug which would break ranged units from firing projectiles is fixed.


The Maps:

-Atlantis city is a massive sprawling city for you and your armies to explore.  The city has 2 sides with 3 bridges connecting the 2 sides.  This beautiful city is in a deep canyon with water falls and lush trees surrounding the city.

- War torn is a open map with a desert like environment.  A massive wall separates the 2 sides with multiple choke points.  Parts of  the wall can be navigated by the AI, so set up your ranged defenses wisely!


  Thank you for being awesome everyone!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Hot Fix - Issues With Custom Units & Vanishing Modded Characters
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've been listening carefully to your issues and addressing them as quickly as possible.  

- The new issues with custom units not working properly in both the menu and in game have been fixed.

- The issue with modded units often vanishing(and often other normal units) has been fixed.

- Modded units size is taken more into account in both the spacing of the unit ranks and their collision with eachother.  Keep in mind the battle editor still does not show the accurate army size of unusual size modded units.  This will change soon.

- The animation speeds of running and walking better adjust to the size and speed of the modded unit.


  More fixes and updates will be on the way.  Enjoy!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Steam Workshop & Modding - Update On Development Progress
notes.content:

  It's coming, don't worry!  The actual development for the character mod tools and importing are basically finished and are in beta.  Now the next step is integrating Steam Workshop.   Thank you all for your patience.  I hope to have this out in under a week or so.(please do not quote me on that)

PS, That annoying bug with custom units not attacking will be fixed!


Kind regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Improvements To Unit Ordering & Combat - Beta V0.5!
notes.content:
Hey everyone.  I've given some much needed attention to unit ordering and combat while in possession.  Welcome to beta 0.5!


Unit Ordering:

- Units now continue with their last order if you leave your possessed unit.

- Units will defend themselves while attempting to follow an order if needed.

- Fixed issues with units not attacking(going brain dead) when given the attack order.

- Green ring is shown around player showing his rally range when in order menu.

- Green arrow is shown to give the player the precise location where he is about to order his units to.

- If the player leaves a possessed leader, that character will continue to be his units leader, but the units will not follow him.  If the player possess that individual again, he can continue giving those units orders.



Combat:

- Kill & death count added for player while in possession.

- Damage indicator tells the player how much damage he has dealt to enemy while in possession.

- Kill and death message upon getting a kill or dying.

- While in combat as melee, pointing at other enemies makes your character target them if they are in range.

- As of the last update you are no longer restricted to attack only when in range.



  Other small fixes and changes were made.  For those of you who were hoping for more units and maps, stay epic, they are coming. ;)


Regards,

Robert.

notes.content:
Welcome to Beta 0.4!  Lots of very exciting new features and fixes.  All of these new features took a great deal of man hours to develop.

notes.title: The Future Of UEBS
notes.content:
Hello everyone.  Robert here.  Today I want to talk about the future of UEBS, and directions I would like to take.  Below, I will go over some of the future content and changes I would like to see happen by version 1.0.  Much of this is based on your feedback so far.  Also, keep in mind that I do not plan to stop working on the game after version 1.0.


Content:

- LOTS more units.  I plan to add a great deal of Units.  I have been reading the requested Units and I plan to try to get the most popular ones in the game, plus many more.  Some are already in the works.

- At least 8 maps by full release.  8 is my current goal, but I'm sure there will be more beyond release.

- "God powers".  The nuke is the first "god power" I have added to the game.  God powers give the player the power to change battles in a very dramatic way.  God powers will need to be unlocked by the player.



Gameplay, AI & Bugs:

- Improved gameplay and 'feel' while possessing.  Player needs more control and feedback which aims to improve the experience of playing as a soldier.  Some features may include, damage indicators, kill indicators and more freedom with enemy targeting and attacking.

- Improvements in ordering system. I aim to improve this by giving the player more feedback and adding more orders, as well having the AI function better with those orders.

- AI advancements.  Though improving AI is extremely difficult and complex on such a scale, I'm trying my best.  One improvement I want to see are ranged units being aware of targets being obscured(This is far more complicated than it sounds on this scale).


Workshop:
  Modding is one of the most requested features for this game.  I plan to look in modding once version 1.0 is released.  I feel the game needs to be more complete before I put time into this.  


  These are only some of the things I wish to add.  I want to thank everyone for showing such an overwhelming amount of support for this project.  PS, the first content update is on the way.

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Beta Release & Performance Tips
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  I'm Robert, the developer of UEBS.  So the beta is finally released.  I want to thank everyone for the amazing support so far!  I want to cover a few things in this thread.  Being an early build, there will be bugs.  Please report any bugs you find on these forums.  Below, I want to give everyone a few tips about performance and understanding the graphics settings made available.

 

  First, I want to state that the crowd system requires memory.  Crowds are made of a great deal of meshes which require memory.  If you are having memory problems, try lowering the 'Character Animation' quality in settings.  This plays a huge factor into the amount of memory used in this game.


  Second, the rest of the settings play a significant role in the overall frame rate and performance you will get in the game.  

- The jump from high to ultra shadow quality is one of the most noticeable performance differences.  This is because each character casts his own shadow in Ultra.

- Character LOD can have a fairly significant impact on your performance but can make the characters have LOD popping issues when on low.  

- Terrain settings affect the over all detail in the environment terrains and trees which can also have a significant impact on FPS.

  That mostly covers performance tips.  I hope you all enjoy the beta, I'm so incredibly excited to continue working on this game and see what you all do in this sand box!

Regards,

Robert.
